answer: A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The tundra counter is kept in inlet and beacon publishes each reset. An copycat thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1723 identities would post 4897 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
